sentences: I check the font size in the document settings before printing the final draft.
I select a serif typeface for the body text and a sans-serif for the headings.
I adjust the kerning between specific letter pairs to remove awkward gaps.
I set the leading to one and a half times the font size for readability.
I apply bold weight to the key terms in the glossary for emphasis.
I italicize the foreign phrases in the manuscript according to the style guide.
I inspect the font family name in the CSS file to ensure consistency.
I convert the text to outlines before sending the logo to the printer.
I install the new font file by dragging it into the system font folder.
I compare the x-height of two typefaces to see which one looks larger.
I enable ligatures in the OpenType panel to combine the f and i characters.
I check the font's license agreement before embedding it in the PDF.
I set the fallback font to Arial in case the primary web font fails to load.
I measure the baseline shift of the superscript numbers in the footnote.
I adjust the tracking to make the small caps text fit the column width.
I preview the variable font's weight axis by sliding the control in the panel.
I clear the font cache on my computer when the menu shows outdated names.
I select the oldstyle figures option for numbers in the running text.
I check the glyph coverage of the font for the Cyrillic alphabet.
I export the font subset with only the characters used in the document.
